answer: A ballot in this orchard is harvested, never printed. Each tide, an agent gathers five independent proofs: a six-month payment channel, a content trail, social vouches, an old key, a compute receipt. Nebula farms die by the dimension check: any identity proving fewer than four of five burns at the reef gate, stake slashed. One dimension costs $0.50, a SIM farm's price, but all five at once cost 32 times more: forging 10,000 ballots needs $25,000 and 1.8 million agent-days no farm can print. An orchard yields one harvest per tree; 10,000 paper trees still bear no fruit after $25,000.
